$comment: Channel-owned, extensible list -- validates against design-system/schemas/src/post-archetype.schema.json, one entry per element. NOT a closed global enum; only the archetype(s) actually exercised so far are listed here.

archetypes.label: Product Promotion
archetypes.description: Promotes a specific Kaduse product (e.g. a stethoscope) directly -- distinct from a comparison, a news/announcement post, or an important-day post. User-approved 2026-09-04 (Batch K2A). Detailed subtype/content rules live in channels/kaduse-medikal/content/policies/product-promotion.json, not in this registry entry -- this schema has no field for approval status or subtypes, so approval is recorded in the policy file instead.

archetypes.label: Product Comparison
archetypes.description: Objectively compares exactly two different Ana Seri (series) product families using authoritative catalog facts -- distinct from Product Promotion's same-series variant showcase. User-approved 2026-09-04 (Batch K2A). Detailed cardinality/content rules live in channels/kaduse-medikal/content/policies/product-comparison.json.

archetypes.label: Research / Scientific Research
archetypes.description: Presents and explains a specific published study (study-centric: what did the study examine and find) -- distinct from Medical News (event/development-centric: what happened). Supersedes the earlier candidate label 'Clinical Evidence / Research Summary', which is not a separate active canonical archetype. User-approved 2026-09-04 (Batch K2B). Detailed content-structure/evidence rules live in channels/kaduse-medikal/content/policies/research.json.
